policy: Windows-native qualification remains intentionally deferred through major product-capability buildout; Phase 19 source completion never implies native PASS, GA, universal repairability, or destructive recovery authority.

items.windowsApiDependency: Windows service runtime, persistent IPC v7, principal identity
items.requiredNativeScenario: Start, observe, cancel, complete, then rapidly restart Deep Scan through the installed non-elevated desktop shell and privileged service boundary; exercise stale cancel/late-worker windows.
items.expectedEvidence: Principal-bound request/response and streamed DeepScanSnapshot events; generation N cleanup/cancellation never clears or overwrites generation N+1 state.

items.windowsApiDependency: SetupAPI / Configuration Manager / Windows Update Agent through existing Driver Hub
items.requiredNativeScenario: Healthy devices, missing driver, device problem code, applicable driver update and vendor-managed update.
items.expectedEvidence: Authoritative driver/device snapshots normalize to stable privacy-preserving facts and expected findings without duplicate alarms.

items.windowsApiDependency: WMI/CIM, storage reliability providers, NVMe/SMART paths used by diagnostic-engine
items.requiredNativeScenario: Healthy disk, warning disk, explicit uncorrected error, unavailable SMART/NVMe metrics, normal and high memory pressure.
items.expectedEvidence: Factual telemetry and bounded findings; unavailable metrics remain diagnostic limitations rather than health failures.

items.windowsApiDependency: Windows Event Log / WHEA / minidump metadata through diagnostic-engine
items.requiredNativeScenario: Recent WHEA corrected/uncorrected evidence and bugchecks at strong, moderate, weak, unrelated and stale time separations, including hardware evidence after a crash.
items.expectedEvidence: Corrected/fatal semantics remain distinct; weak coincidence never becomes a Critical combined Finding; correlated Findings expose time distance, contributing evidence, strength and uncertainty without unsupported causation.

items.windowsApiDependency: DISM/SFC/CHKDSK assessment paths and Windows servicing preflight through system-repair
items.requiredNativeScenario: Verified healthy servicing result, repairable corruption result, servicing failure and reboot-precondition state.
items.expectedEvidence: Healthy results produce no warning; non-healthy results produce a bounded Windows finding and a sensitive remediation candidate only.

items.windowsApiDependency: Registry/Task Scheduler/startup discovery and filesystem cleanup discovery through existing engines
items.requiredNativeScenario: Normal startup, multiple high-impact startup entries, safe reclaimable data and recovery-sensitive exclusions.
items.expectedEvidence: Read-only scan produces recommendations only; no startup or cleanup mutation occurs during Deep Scan.

items.windowsApiDependency: Long-running WMI/RPC/Event Log/WUA/native calls plus ReadBudgetManager
items.requiredNativeScenario: Inject stalled collectors, exhaust read budgets, cancel during each batch, rapidly restart scans, and allow an old native worker to exit after the next generation begins.
items.expectedEvidence: No unbounded stall; new work stops on cancellation; partial results are preserved; stale workers cannot alter the current generation or its cancellation token; resource budgets remain bounded.

items.windowsApiDependency: Named-pipe/persistent IPC v7 event bus and renderer reconnect behavior
items.requiredNativeScenario: Disconnect/reconnect renderer during an active scan and stress intermediate progress volume.
items.expectedEvidence: Hydration restores authoritative current state; coalescing prevents event flood; terminal finding state is never lost or duplicated.

items.windowsApiDependency: WebView2/Tauri desktop runtime, Windows input/accessibility settings
items.requiredNativeScenario: Keyboard-only EN/AR flows, RTL, 200% text scale, reduced motion, reduced transparency, increased contrast and screen reader navigation.
items.expectedEvidence: Pointerdown feedback remains interruptible, no fake progress animation, focus order is usable, severity is not color-only, and live announcements are restrained.

items.windowsApiDependency: Representative Windows hardware and provider latency
items.requiredNativeScenario: Run Deep Scan on low/mid/high-spec PCs while measuring CPU, disk, memory, collector durations and event volume.
items.expectedEvidence: The scan remains bounded and does not materially saturate CPU/disk; per-class concurrency and duration telemetry are captured.

items.windowsApiDependency: Deployed SQLite WAL database upgraded through schema v10 to v11
items.requiredNativeScenario: Upgrade a representative Phase 17 schema-v10 database containing scans/findings/overrides/sealed plans to v11, restart service, and verify verification/resolution metadata plus all prior rows.
items.expectedEvidence: No prior rows or finding IDs are lost; ignored state and finding JSON remain compatible; new verification fields receive deterministic defaults; schema checksum remains stable.

items.windowsApiDependency: Service persistence and future MutationSupervisor handoff
items.requiredNativeScenario: Select/deselect candidates before consent, seal a plan, restart service and verify digest/action set identity remains unchanged.
items.expectedEvidence: Sealed plan is immutable and principal-bound; no Phase 17 path executes the proposed actions.

items.windowsApiDependency: Windows registry / SMBIOS-derived machine identity
items.requiredNativeScenario: Validate manufacturer/model/family/build on OEM laptop, OEM desktop and self-built PC; confirm serial/UUID are neither collected nor persisted.
items.expectedEvidence: MachineKind is proven as OEM/SelfBuilt/Unknown without retail-motherboard false OEM classification; serial/UUID remain excluded.

items.windowsApiDependency: Live WUA plus official vendor/OEM infrastructure
items.requiredNativeScenario: Exercise applicable/empty/timeout/offline/partial provider responses and official redirect/CDN behavior.
items.expectedEvidence: Per-device coverage becomes CompleteForRequiredAuthorities only when every required authority is sufficiently evaluated; offline/manual/unavailable states never claim Up to date.

items.subsystem: Driver package Authenticode and publisher trust
items.windowsApiDependency: WinVerifyTrust / catalog trust on real driver packages
items.requiredNativeScenario: Validate trusted Microsoft/vendor package, unexpected publisher, invalid/unsigned/test-signed package and signer extraction.
items.expectedEvidence: WinVerifyTrust success is accompanied by extracted signer subject/strong certificate identity and provider-approved signer matching; valid wrong-publisher packages fail closed.

items.windowsApiDependency: NTFS ACLs, reparse/symlink/hardlink semantics
items.requiredNativeScenario: Stage a verified package then attack substitution, rename, reparse and hardlink windows before privileged handoff.
items.expectedEvidence: Staging resists substitution and privileged revalidation detects any changed package identity.

items.windowsApiDependency: WUA / supported driver servicing / restore point / driver backup
items.requiredNativeScenario: Install real independent drivers and missing-device driver; exercise backup, restore point, failure before/after mutation, rollback and reboot aggregation.
items.expectedEvidence: Each item is journaled independently; recovery evidence exists before mutation; failures contain subsequent dependent work.

items.windowsApiDependency: SetupAPI / Configuration Manager / WUA result
items.requiredNativeScenario: After install and after reboot, re-read device presence, problem code, provider/version/INF and WUA result.
items.expectedEvidence: Success is journaled only when post-install evidence matches the sealed action or an explicit reboot-pending state.

items.windowsApiDependency: NVIDIA App / AMD official update tooling / Intel Driver & Support Assistant
items.requiredNativeScenario: Detect installed/not-installed official utilities and exercise launch/support routing without claiming AetherCore direct installation.
items.expectedEvidence: Utility presence is represented only as management authority; update availability remains UnknownUntilVendorCheck unless live vendor evidence proves an update.

items.windowsApiDependency: Future provider-specific driver package executor
items.requiredNativeScenario: When a DirectTrusted provider is introduced, prove frozen package identity, elevated revalidation and supported servicing contract before enabling selection.
items.expectedEvidence: Renderer cannot inject URL/path; exact verified package is the only privileged input and plan substitution fails closed.

items.windowsApiDependency: Installed Tauri/WebView2, keyboard, accessibility tree
items.requiredNativeScenario: Exercise 1 and 50+ devices, long names, mixed Arabic/Latin IDs, keyboard-only selection/preferences, reduced motion/transparency/contrast and reboot states.
items.expectedEvidence: No unbounded interaction regression; technical values remain LTR islands; all state is perceivable without color alone.

items.windowsApiDependency: WinVerifyTrust/CryptQueryObject/certificate chain APIs
items.requiredNativeScenario: Extract signer subject, certificate thumbprint or stronger key identity, chain status, and test-signing state from real Microsoft/NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/OEM driver packages.
items.expectedEvidence: Typed SignatureVerification is populated with real identity evidence; validity-only evidence cannot satisfy expected publisher policy.

items.windowsApiDependency: Real vendor signing chains and rotation behavior
items.requiredNativeScenario: Build and validate approved signer sets/rotation policy per implemented direct provider before any DirectTrusted enablement.
items.expectedEvidence: No display-name substring trust; provider policy uses approved certificate/public-key identities with documented rotation handling.

items.windowsApiDependency: Dell/Lenovo/HP/ASUS/Acer/MSI/Surface official tooling/support ecosystems
items.requiredNativeScenario: On representative OEM machines, validate authority applicability, official utility/manual routing, provider availability and absence of fabricated machine-readable capability.
items.expectedEvidence: DeviceAuthorityCoverage matches real OEM applicability and remains ManualAuthorityRequired/ProviderUnavailable until an adapter genuinely evaluates update availability.

items.windowsApiDependency: NVIDIA App / AMD software / Intel Driver & Support Assistant
items.requiredNativeScenario: Exercise installed/not-installed/unavailable utility states and independently prove update/no-update/unknown results where official tooling exposes them.
items.expectedEvidence: Utility presence never increments update counts; UpdateAvailable appears only with concrete vendor evidence linked to a candidate/update identity.

items.windowsApiDependency: Live WUA plus applicable OEM/component authorities
items.requiredNativeScenario: Test generic Microsoft-only devices, OEM-specific devices, self-built GPU systems, offline systems, and provider failure/partial cases.
items.expectedEvidence: Strong Up to date is emitted only when all required authorities for that device were sufficiently evaluated; exact reason for incompleteness is preserved.

items.windowsApiDependency: NTFS ACL/reparse/hardlink/file identity semantics under elevation
items.requiredNativeScenario: Attempt substitution, hardlink, junction/reparse, rename, ACL and time-of-check/time-of-use attacks across user staging and privileged revalidation.
items.expectedEvidence: Exact signed package identity, signer policy, hash, applicability and safe path are revalidated after privilege transition immediately before mutation.

items.windowsApiDependency: DISM API / DismCheckImageHealth plus DISM RestoreHealth
items.requiredNativeScenario: Healthy, repairable, source-required and non-repairable online images across supported Windows builds; mutate then rescan.
items.expectedEvidence: Structured health classification matches Windows state; RestoreHealth runs only for a still-repairable image; verification proves or rejects success; source-required/non-repairable escalates without false resolution.

items.windowsApiDependency: sfc.exe plus bounded CBS [SR] evidence
items.requiredNativeScenario: Healthy system, repairable protected-file violation, unresolved violation and non-English Windows UI; exercise /verifyonly and /scannow.
items.expectedEvidence: Localized console prose is never authority; bounded CBS evidence and a fresh verify pass cannot falsely resolve a Finding.

items.subsystem: Windows Update diagnosis and targeted service repair
items.windowsApiDependency: Windows Update Agent COM plus Service Control Manager
items.requiredNativeScenario: Online healthy WUA, WU_E_NO_CONNECTION, WSUS/policy errors, wuauserv stopped/disabled, servicing contention and post-service-start retry.
items.expectedEvidence: Offline is not corruption; policy/unknown errors remain bounded; only diagnosis-scoped service authority mutates and WUA discovery verifies the user-visible issue.

items.subsystem: Network, DNS and proxy repair intelligence
items.windowsApiDependency: Windows networking/DNS/WinHTTP policy surfaces selected by future/available providers
items.requiredNativeScenario: DHCP failure, DNS-only failure, malformed proxy, enterprise-managed proxy, offline adapter and Winsock candidate on managed/unmanaged systems.
items.expectedEvidence: Root-cause rules do not infer DNS/Winsock from generic offline state; enterprise proxy is never silently removed; high-impact resets stay consent/reboot gated.

items.windowsApiDependency: CHKDSK online scan, boot-time/offline filesystem servicing
items.requiredNativeScenario: Healthy NTFS, online-detected repair need, busy system volume, reboot-required repair and concurrent storage hardware warning.
items.expectedEvidence: Filesystem evidence stays separate from physical disk health; no /f, /r, format, partition or raw-disk path runs automatically; offline repair requires explicit qualified flow.

items.subsystem: Recovery readiness, restore point and WinRE
items.windowsApiDependency: System Restore / VSS integration and REAgentC/WinRE supported state
items.requiredNativeScenario: Restore disabled, restore creation success/failure, WinRE enabled/disabled/unavailable and recovery protection loss before sensitive repair.
items.expectedEvidence: UI never claims recovery protection from resource presence; missing mandatory protection blocks or escalates the relevant action exactly as the sealed graph states.

items.subsystem: Repair reinstall and destructive recovery availability
items.windowsApiDependency: Supported Windows recovery / repair reinstall surfaces
items.requiredNativeScenario: Supported and unsupported Windows editions/builds; preserve-files reset guidance; repair reinstall availability; data-backup warning.
items.expectedEvidence: Availability is detected rather than assumed; Level 4/5 actions remain guided/manual unless separately qualified; destructive recovery never runs silently.

items.subsystem: Reboot resume, mutation contention and interrupted repair
items.windowsApiDependency: SQLite WAL, service restart, MutationSupervisor, machine mutation guard
items.requiredNativeScenario: Reboot barrier, service restart before/after mutation, concurrent driver/update repair, stale consent after state change and fresh post-reboot assessment.
items.expectedEvidence: Pre-reboot plan is never replayed as mutation authority; stale fingerprint/graph fails closed; interrupted mutation reports precise outcome and requires fresh verification/recovery.

items.windowsApiDependency: Tauri/WebView2, Narrator, keyboard, Windows accessibility preferences
items.requiredNativeScenario: Keyboard-only Repair review/execution in EN/AR, RTL technical islands, 200% text, Narrator, reduced motion/transparency and increased contrast.
items.expectedEvidence: Plan selection/recovery/reboot/error semantics remain understandable; progress announcements are restrained; no animation lockout or fake percentage occurs.

items.subsystem: Phase 19 build, migration and privileged boundary qualification
items.windowsApiDependency: Rust/MSVC Windows toolchain, SQLite schema v13, signed installed service/renderer boundary
items.requiredNativeScenario: Compile/test full workspace on supported Windows; upgrade representative v12 DB to v13; fuzz typed repair IPC; attempt command/service/path/plan substitution.
items.expectedEvidence: Workspace compiles/tests; history survives migration; renderer cannot inject executable, command, service, registry/path mutation or bypass recovery/reboot graph invariants.

items.windowsApiDependency: n/a (unix provider)
items.requiredNativeScenario: Validate Mach host_statistics64/vm64/sysctl/proc_pidinfo collectors across Apple Silicon AND Intel Macs, multiple macOS majors, and under heavy load / low-memory conditions; confirm tick-delta correctness across sleep/wake.
items.notes: Validated on this Apple Silicon host only (P27). Intel + macOS-version spread deferred to P28+ qualification.

items.windowsApiDependency: n/a (unix provider)
items.requiredNativeScenario: Run the /proc-based provider across a kernel-version matrix (LTS bounds) and representative distros; verify parser tolerance to layout drift (diskstats fields added by newer kernels), cgroup-v2 memory accounting deltas, and thermal-zone absence paths.
items.notes: Proven via fixture tests on macOS; live Linux validation requires real hardware. QD-026-002 notes refined in docs/phase27: storage queue metrics are proxies and stay Degraded.

items.windowsApiDependency: n/a (unix provider; Windows behavior frozen)
items.requiredNativeScenario: Live firewall rule-state enumeration (pfctl -s all / ufw status verbose / nft list ruleset) requires an elevated probe lane. Verify config-presence inference against REAL enforced state across pf/ufw/nftables hosts, including disabled-but-configured firewalls where config presence overstates posture.
items.expectedEvidence: Elevated probe runbook output joined with audit findings on at least one host per product; documented divergence between config-present and state-enabled.
items.qualificationHook: NOT_EXECUTED(elevated firewall-state probes) recorded in P32 scorecard; config-file presence only.
items.notes: macOS pf.conf exists but packet filter may be disabled (pfctl -d). Findings carry confidence=inferred and Advisory severity only.

items.windowsApiDependency: n/a (unix provider)
items.requiredNativeScenario: On macOS, password policy lives in OpenDirectory (pwpolicy / Mobile account profiles), not in login.defs-style files. A live lane needs an OpenDirectory read path plus a Linux shadow-utils comparison matrix. The macOS lane currently reports typed NotAvailable by construction.
items.expectedEvidence: OpenDirectory-backed provider validated against local + bound directory hosts; login.defs values cross-checked with pam_pwquality effective policy on Linux.
items.qualificationHook: NotAvailable(sec.notAvailable.platformPaths) emitted honestly on macOS; file lint fully proven on Linux fixtures.
items.notes: Requested-but-unavailable targets echo the typed reason verbatim in the lane report.

items.windowsApiDependency: n/a (offline DB)
items.requiredNativeScenario: The seeded NVD-derived DB is a point-in-time snapshot (36 curated entries). A governance process must define: refresh cadence, source-of-truth review before pin rotation, dual-signature or owner-acknowledgement for manifest rewrites, and rollback pins. Runtime network stays banned forever; refreshes arrive ONLY through explicit owner action (aetherctl vulndb update --from).
items.expectedEvidence: Owner-approved governance note defining cadence + reviewer; two consecutive manifest rotations exercised via the CLI path with rollback proof.
items.qualificationHook: Manifest pin verified at load (fail-closed); GD-5 tamper proof; CLI update path validate-before-write with rollback.
items.notes: DB staleness is visible to the user via the report schema (digest changes with every DB swap).
